name: asp_team_invitation
description: 指定本人邀请、队长可转发分享授权及本人接受事实。分享不公开队内名单；离队后不重放旧授权

columns.name: inviter_person_id
columns.description: 分享授权时的队长稳定档案，转让或账号停止后失效；旧定向邀请为空

columns.name: target_person_id
columns.description: 指定受邀人；share 分享授权为空，接受后另插指定本人事实

columns.name: invitation_kind
columns.description: direct 定向邀请或分享接受事实；share 可转发队伍授权

columns.name: invite_token
columns.description: 256位随机业务链接凭据，仅当前队长回显；不进日志、通知或匿名预览，不授予成员资料权限

columns.name: expires_at
columns.description: 分享授权七天到期；旧定向邀请不设到期；有时区业务时间

columns.name: share_invitation_id
columns.description: 本人接受分享的来源；同来源同本人仅一次，结束成员后不复活

columns.name: status
columns.description: 独立业务状态；合法值不等于业务已获批准：pending accepted declined revoked invalidated

checks: (invitation_kind = 'direct' AND target_person_id IS NOT NULL AND invite_token IS NULL AND expires_at IS NULL) OR (invitation_kind = 'share' AND target_person_id IS NULL AND inviter_person_id IS NOT NULL AND invite_token IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND share_invitation_id IS NULL AND status IN ('pending', 'revoked', 'invalidated'))
share_invitation_id IS NULL OR (invitation_kind = 'direct' AND status = 'accepted' AND share_invitation_id <> id)
responsibility: 应用服务执行状态转换、授权和跨记录一致性，数据库约束只是结构防线。
